profile_text: As a subsidiary of the Australian Breville Group, this German-based firm excels in designing and distributing premium kitchen appliances, driving its remarkable 170.6% growth. With a focus on high-end products, the company has established itself as a key player in the market, leveraging its expertise to meet the evolving needs of consumers. Its rapid expansion is reflected in its employee base, which has surged to 46 employees in 2024, earning it a 'Gazelle' categorization.
